what: What Dolby's TrueHD object path does with every object presentation in one library, and what a hundred and ninety of them say about a correlation that six had made look perfect
why: the refusal had been chased on six titles, three of each. Six is enough to find a field that correlates perfectly and not enough to know whether it means anything
method: `tools/dolby_truehd_sweep.py`: twenty seconds from the head of every TrueHD track that declares a sixteen-channel presentation, wrapped in MP4 because Dolby's parser will not read a raw elementary stream, through `dlbtruehdparse ! dlbtruehddec out-ch-config=21 presentation=16`. Every field `info --json` reports is recorded, and `tools/split_fields.py` looks for one that takes disjoint values on the two sides
so_it_is_not_three_titles: it is nearly half the library. Shaun of the Dead and Knives Out sit alongside A Quiet Place, three John Wick films, three Thor films, Aliens, Apocalypse Now and Dredd. A question that looked like three odd streams is a question about most of a catalogue

the_verdict_is_a_property_of_the_stream.repeatable: the same file gives the same answer three runs running
the_verdict_is_a_property_of_the_stream.not_the_cut_length: A Quiet Place is refused at 20, 60 and 180 seconds of input
the_verdict_is_a_property_of_the_stream.specific_to_the_object_mode: A Quiet Place decodes at `presentation=16` with the default channel configuration and at `presentation=2` with `out-ch-config=21`; only the two together are refused
the_verdict_is_a_property_of_the_stream.and_another_decoder_opens_it: `truehdd` decodes its presentation 3 and finds twelve elements

what_a_bigger_sample_does_to_2ch_control.the_six_title_reading: set in all three Dolby opened, clear in all three it refused -- a perfect correlation, which this report already knew it could not test
what_a_bigger_sample_does_to_2ch_control.reading: the flag is clear in most of both sets and set in a minority of both. It predicts nothing. The perfect correlation across six titles was the six titles

the_field_that_nearly_splits_them.field: channel_meaning.twoch_dialogue_norm, the two-channel presentation's dialogue norm
the_field_that_nearly_splits_them.rule: a value between 32 and 37 goes with opening and a value outside it -- 63, which is the field's maximum and means nothing was written, or 31, which is what the other presentations carry -- goes with refusal
the_field_that_nearly_splits_them.what_it_is_not: a cause. The mutation instrument is dead for TrueHD: the object path refuses any stream whose major sync was edited, whatever the edit says, including edits to fields that cannot be causal. This is a correlation on a hundred and ninety streams instead of six, which is worth more than the old one and is still a correlation
the_field_that_nearly_splits_them.why_it_is_the_same_family_as_the_old_rea: both are about whether the two-channel presentation carries control data of its own. The flag says whether to honour it; the dialogue norm is the value. On six titles the two moved together, which is why the flag looked perfect

how_much_it_is_worth.method: rank every usable field by how many rows no partition of its values can classify. A field unrelated to the verdict leaves about as many as the smaller side has
how_much_it_is_worth.reading: this is not one candidate among many, which is what the configuration-0 conjunction turned out to be. It is one field an order of magnitude clear of every other, on a set split 105 to 89 where chance has no room to produce it. Association, still not cause

no_field_splits_them: over every field `info --json` reports -- and it now reports the channel meaning, which it did not before this sweep -- nothing takes disjoint values on the two sides. Nor does any pair: of the 3 486 pairs formable from the 84 fields that are neither counts nor near-unique, **none** splits them. Substream layout, extended substream info, flags, object count, mix level, sampling rate and major-sync cadence are distributed alike
classification: Dolby-tool-unsupported rather than spec-invalid or oadec-invalid. An output mode that opens 54 per cent of a catalogue's Atmos titles and refuses the rest, with no bitstream field separating them, is more plausibly a property of that mode than of the streams -- and two other decoders open all of them
